title: Sculpting the Latent Space: Disentanglement with WAE-MMD and Programmable Priors
abstract: arXiv:2510.11953v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning disentangled representations, where semantic features are independently captured in a latent space, is dominated by Variational Auto Encoders (VAE) and Adversarial Training. In this paper, we provide direct quantitative and visual evidence that these methods consistently fail to enforce the target factorized representation on the aggregate posterior, leading to entangled representations. We quantify this failure using the Latent Predictability Score (LPS), an unsupervised metric of mutual predictability that empirically lower bounds the level of entanglement in a latent space. To address these limitations, we leverage the non-parametric Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to directly sculpt the aggregate posterior enabling programmable priors. translated_title: 雕塑潜空间：基于WAE-MMD与可编程先验的解耦表示学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.11953v2 公告类型：replace。摘要：学习解耦表示——即让语义特征在潜空间中被独立捕捉——目前主要由变分自编码器（VAE）和对抗训练主导。在本文中，我们提供了直接的定量与视觉证据，表明这些方法始终无法在聚合后验上强制实现目标因子化表示，从而导致表示纠缠。我们使用潜空间可预测性分数（Latent Predictability Score, LPS）来量化这种失败，LPS是一种无监督的相互可预测性度量，从经验上为潜空间中的纠缠程度提供下界。为解决这些局限性，我们利用非参数化的最大均值差异（MMD）直接对聚合后验进行塑形，从而实现可编程先验。我们证明了：（1）在无监督统计独立性方面达到最先进水平，与领先的基线方法相比，检测到的纠缠减少了70%；（2）可以灵活地选择性地注入……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过非参数化MMD直接塑形聚合后验，提出支持可编程先验的WAE-MMD方法，并引入无监督纠缠度量LPS，使潜空间纠缠度降低70%，实现无监督解耦表示学习的最先进水平。
